item.title: Soma 1.0 (855)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (855)

  • Tasks can have contributors: add as many people as you like besides the owner, on Mac, iPhone and iPad. A person’s page lists the tasks they help with, tagged Contributor.
  • Clicking a task now opens the full editor straight away.
  • Export a person’s work as a PDF report: open tasks (overdue in red), done tasks, projects, plan items, priorities and more, with page numbers.
  • Show in Hierarchy glides to the person, and their card grows, wobbles and settles so you can’t miss it.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).
